caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing human figure. The figure is dressed in a brown tunic with puffy sleeves and a yellowish border at the hem, paired with trousers that have visible sectioned bands, giving a padded appearance, and black shoes. A greenish-blue sash drapes over the left shoulder and across the front of the body, ending at the right side, with a matching fabric wrapped around the head in a turban-like manner. The figure's left hand is raised and placed over the chest while the right arm hangs down, with a bracelet around the wrist. The figure has dark brown skin, circular earrings, and prominent carved facial features including a straight nose and large eyes. The base of the statue is green and angular with visible facet lines. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige, and the artist's signature, "Charles Downing," appears towards the lower right.
title: Cigar Store Indian
